# Deep Dive: A Barbell Approach

Report 103 | Published 2023-02-08 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2023-2-8/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/103.json)

Defensive income alongside selective risk.

The report improves its treatment of TGA and RRP offsets and correctly anticipates debt-limit resolution and a credit-spread widening episode. The first-half sideways case understated the rally. Its banking reassurance still overlooks duration and deposit-flight risk. Bitcoin gains over three years are clear; HDB and ITUB illustrate sharply different equity outcomes. Ordinals and Nostr mechanisms are substantially sound, with overstated permanence/censorship implications and unverified adoption diagnostics.

**Coverage:** All article text blocks were read. Ledger covers material macro, investment, and causal propositions; incidental descriptive statistics, boilerplate, and unreasoned position lists are excluded. Image labels were read, not image pixels.

### 103-C13

**Witness-storage inscriptions**

| Field | Assessment |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | Right |
| Type | explanation |
| Horizon | Not specified |
| Conditions | Not specified |
| Author modality | asserted |
| Asset or variable | bitcoin-inscriptions-witness-discount |
| Source blocks | 67, 75 |
| Thesis family | bitcoin-inscriptions-witness-discount |

The handbook confirms on-chain Taproot witness inscriptions. BIP141 gives witness bytes one-quarter the weight of base bytes; actual fees still depend on fee rate and transaction overhead. Four million weight units do not mean a full four-megabyte image plus arbitrary other transaction data.

**Direction:** Supported within the defined test.

**Timing:** No numerical deadline was stated.

**Mechanism:** See rationale; this is not a forecast hit.

**Reviewer confidence:** medium

**Outcome evidence:**

- [Segregated Witness specification](https://github.com/bitcoin/bips/blob/master/bip-0141.mediawiki) | Bitcoin BIP authors | Verified in the audit

Block weight equals base size times three plus total size, capped at four million; witness bytes cost one weight unit versus four for base bytes. Not a fixed fee discount independent of fee rate.

- [Inscriptions handbook](https://docs.ordinals.com/inscriptions.html) | Ordinals project | Verified in the audit

Content is stored on-chain in Taproot script-path witness data, using unexecuted envelopes; commit/reveal transactions create inscriptions.

## Framework lessons

- Distinguish protocol capability from adoption.

## Verification limitations

- Captured website text is not an authenticated publication-date version.
- Chart-only numerical claims have not been visually verified.
- Selected stock/ETF adjusted-close comparisons are disclosed where used; no reconstructed portfolio backtest has been performed.
- Unresolved verdicts are not forecast failures or successes; no aggregate hit rate is inferred.
